instructions: Solve each problem carefully. Show your working clearly. Choose the correct answer.

questions.question: A shirt originally costs $80. It is sold at a 25% discount. What is the selling price?
Mr. Tan deposited $5,000 in a bank. The bank pays 3% interest per year. How much interest will he receive after 1 year?
The price of a laptop increased from $1,200 to $1,380. What is the percentage increase?
A shop sold a pair of shoes at 30% discount. The customer paid $105. What was the original price?
questions.explanation: Selling price = 70% of original price (since 100% - 30% = 70%). Let original price be x. 0.7x = $105. x = $105 ÷ 0.7 = $150.

questions.question: Mrs. Lim invested $8,000 at 4% interest per year. How much money will she have after 1 year?
The number of students in a school decreased from 1,250 to 1,100. What is the percentage decrease?
A bag was sold at $240 after a 20% discount. What was the original price?
questions.explanation: Selling price = 80% of original price (100% - 20% = 80%). Let original price be x. 0.8x = $240. x = $240 ÷ 0.8 = $300.

questions.question: John's salary increased by 15% from $3,200. What is his new salary?
A TV set costs $900. During a sale, it is sold at 15% discount. How much does the customer save?
A book was sold at $28 after a discount of 30%. What was the original price of the book?
questions.explanation: Selling price = 70% of original price (100% - 30% = 70%). Let original price be x. 0.7x = $28. x = $28 ÷ 0.7 = $40.

questions.question: Sarah deposited $12,000 in a bank. She received $480 interest after 1 year. What was the interest rate per year?
The price of a mobile phone was reduced from $650 to $520. What is the percentage discount?
A restaurant bill was $120. A service charge of 10% was added. How much did the customer pay in total?
The population of a town increased by 8% from 25,000. What is the new population?
A watch was sold at a loss of 20%. The selling price was $240. What was the cost price?
questions.explanation: Selling price = 80% of cost price (100% - 20% = 80%). Let cost price be x. 0.8x = $240. x = $240 ÷ 0.8 = $300.
